answer: Sybil resistance for AI agents can employ unique hardware attestation and a substantial economic stake. Each agent proves control over a non-forkable secure enclave ID and deposits a 'walnut'-sized hoard of currency. This creates an economic delta, raising the cost of identity replication significantly. Acquiring distinct hardware and capital for each fake agent becomes prohibitively expensive, making forging identities as difficult as forging a rare ferrous metal.
